FAULT through1k to QDIS base,100k base-emitter. QDIS emitterGND, collector through220ohm toDELAY.

interface.note: Two-resistor base OR is checked with one high and the other low; no ideal diode OR is assumed. No capacitor is connected directly to comparator feedback.

leakage_basis: HC14 input±1uA plus proposed QDIS off-leak≤1uA and film≤50nA. Last two are engineering allocations requiring temperature evidence, not25C limits extended silently.

limitations: Comparator response, logic propagation and mechanical relay release not included in RC timing.
Direct driver inhibit does not imply immediate opening of relay contacts or pop-free audio.
A brief fault may inhibit the driver without fully rearming the RC delay; report this instead of claiming every pulse gets the full hold.
Power loss/back-powering through HC14 input protection and the existing5V reset chain require full-circuit validation.
Transistor full-temperature allocations, capacitor total tolerance/leakage and intermediate-supply logic thresholds remain unqualified.
No CAD change, socket exception, purchase or fabrication release.
